engineering_assumption: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION: after each blank-to-visible note transition, do not enable the position readout until a KC spike occurs after that cue began; this excludes subthreshold voltage left from the prior cue.
pass_rule: No game or judgements: learned retained weights emit exactly one DOWN per identical current-position sweep at the same sweep-relative tick on all three sweeps; initial weights emit zero DOWN; readout starts for sweeps 2/3 occur only after a post-onset KC spike; one neural simulator remains initialized; exact two-run replay.
scope: Task-free temporal/readout controllability only; no training and no judgement-based tuning
